svg.title: Breast mass decision chart: after checking for cancer emergencies, history and exam, the feel of the lump sorts benign causes (cyst or fibrocystic change, abscess, fibroadenoma) from breast cancer; each column gives the feel, the test that clinches it and what follows

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: 1 · STABLE? check for cancer EMERGENCIES first: cord compression, superior vena cava obstruction, hypercalcemia, febrile

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: 2 · History + exam: where (clock face, depth), size, edge, consistency, mobility · nipple, skin, nodes, the other breast

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: 3 · Image: ULTRASOUND first for a palpable lump, pain, discharge or age < 30 · then diagnostic mammogram

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: older = more likely cancer · NO blood or urine test identifies a breast mass

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: SMOOTH edge · MOBILE · soft or firm · CHANGES with periods · may be tender
